races.paceDynamic: Go Just Do It will take this field along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in the field. With five horses preferring to hold up (In The Gloaming, Sindagan, Jp's Express, Chestnut Palace, Squishy) and only uncertain style runners to challenge early, Go Just Do It can dictate terms without pressure. The heavy ground will stretch out the field and make it difficult for hold-up horses to quicken effectively in the closing stages. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and the lone front-runner who can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Go Just Do It gets an easy lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: Go Just Do It can dictate a steady pace that suits his stamina reserves, making it difficult for the hold-up brigade to close on heavy ground. The combination of tactical advantage and proven heavy ground form creates a winning scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horses Close
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and hold-up horses retain enough kick
scenarios.body: Sindagan and In The Gloaming could use their higher ratings to close late if they can overcome the tactical disadvantage. Heavy ground may not completely blunt their finishing speed if the early pace is crawling.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Solana Beach or In The Gloaming tracks the leader closely
scenarios.body: A horse sitting closer to the pace avoids the closing problems on heavy ground while still having enough left to challenge. This requires tactical awareness from connections to avoid getting caught behind the wall of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Go Just Do It weakens dramatically and multiple horses close
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class could tell despite the tactical setup. This requires Go Just Do It to stop quickly and the hold-up horses to have exceptional finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Go Just Do It's early fractions - if he goes too fast early he'll weaken dramatically in heavy conditions
In The Gloaming's fitness after 206 days off as his rating suggests ability but layoff creates serious doubt
Sindagan's position turning for home as he needs to be close enough to challenge despite hold-up style
Wesley Joyce's 3lb claim on Jp's Express may not be enough to overcome the horse's poor recent form
How Solana Beach positions early will reveal Stack's tactical plan for this completely unexposed runner

races.paceDynamic: Varshini looks the lone natural pace angle with her prominent style, while Glory To Be and Independent Expert can also press forward early. The heavy going will prevent any genuine gallop developing, creating a tactical affair where the pace will be sustainable rather than searching. With most runners preferring to come from off the pace, this sets up perfectly for those who can get into contention early and avoid the inevitable traffic problems. This race shape strongly favors prominent racers and those with early tactical speed who can position close to the pace from the start.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Favors Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Varshini and Glory To Be dominate the early positioning without pressure
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows front runners to control the race while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground through the field on heavy turf. Those with early pace can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly steady and bunches the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where class and finishing kick matter most, suiting those held up with proven ability. Fresh legs and superior ratings begin to tell in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Rails
scenarios.trigger: If the field spreads wide and creates interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Runners drawn low or those hugging the inside rail avoid the worst of the scrimmaging while others get shuffled back. Position and luck in running becomes the decisive factor over pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Collapse Opens Door
scenarios.trigger: If Varshini and the early leaders go too fast or tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The pace finally becomes searching enough to set up the race for a genuine closer to sweep through. Heavy ground stamina and a turn of foot from off the pace proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: Varshini must be watched for early pace - if she doesn't lead or press, the race becomes messy and tactical

Independent Expert needs to overcome poor recent form but has the tactical pace to be involved if bouncing back

Traffic problems likely in straight given heavy ground and hold-up bias - inside draws may have advantage

races.paceDynamic: Tuscan Hills will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a sustainable tempo without early pressure. With five hold-up horses (City Of Memphis, Tina's Indian, Lord Massusus, Cowardofthecounty, Saracen) and only Spicy Margarita racing prominently, the pace will likely be modest early before quickening. The heavy ground at 7f will test stamina reserves in the final furlong as the hold-up brigade launch their challenges. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven heavy ground form who can position closer to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Tuscan Hills and Spicy Margarita are allowed to dictate at their own tempo without early pressure.
scenarios.body: The modest early gallop will leave both pace-setters with enough in reserve to resist the late challengers on this stamina-sapping ground. Hold-up horses will find the combination of heavy turf and lack of early pace against them.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Heavy Ground Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the testing conditions and 7f trip on heavy turf finds out the front runners in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Tuscan Hills and Spicy Margarita will weaken as the heavy ground takes its toll, allowing the better-handicapped hold-up horses to finish strongly. The proven heavy ground performers will come to the fore.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Rising to Top
scenarios.trigger: If City Of Memphis reproduces his best form despite the long absence and gets the right split.
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner's superior ability will shine through once Whelan gets him into clear running from his hold-up position. His class edge will overcome tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Joseph O'Brien Double
scenarios.trigger: If both Cowardofthecounty and Saracen benefit from the trainer's excellent recent form and get perfect rides.
scenarios.body: The in-form stable's tactical acumen will see both runners positioned ideally to exploit any pace collapse. Their recent heavy ground experience will prove crucial.

races.paceDynamic: Nephin Mountain is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely to get an uncontested lead in this heavy ground handicap. With 12 hold-up horses and only Honey Dale offering any prominent support, the pace will be steady to moderate early before quickening late. The heavy conditions will sap stamina and punish those needing to make ground from the rear, while the lack of early speed allows Nephin Mountain to control fractions. This race shape strongly favours early position horses and those with proven heavy ground form over pure hold-up merchants.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Nephin Mountain maintains a comfortable lead without pressure through moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The heavy ground becomes the key factor as late closers struggle to make up ground, allowing the pace-setter to kick clear or those tracking closely to strike. Early position and stamina prove decisive over raw pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the heavy ground doesn't slow the pace enough and Nephin Mountain weakens significantly
scenarios.body: Strong stayers with proven heavy form make their move in the final furlong as the leader fades badly. Class tells as better-rated horses find extra on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Nephin Mountain stops quickly and creates a scramble from halfway
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means several horses are still in contention turning for home, creating a messy finish. Those with recent form and tactical speed benefit from the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Closer
scenarios.trigger: If the heavy ground plays less of a factor and allows strong finishing kicks
scenarios.body: A well-handicapped horse from the rear divisions times their run perfectly as others tire. Fresh legs and a good draw overcome positional disadvantage.

races.paceDynamic: Kitty Bear is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gate, with Manhattan Dandy and Rock Etoile potentially pressing from prominent positions. The lack of early pace pressure means Kitty Bear can set sustainable fractions without being harassed, creating a tactical race where the tempo builds gradually. With 11 of 14 runners employing hold-up tactics, there will be significant traffic problems in the straight as the field bunches up behind the modest gallop. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can avoid the scramble and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks, while pure front-runners and hold-up horses prone to fading will struggle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Kitty Bear gets soft fractions and sustains her effort
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows her to control the race completely, while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic behind the crawling pace. Her recent form suggests she's capable when getting favorable conditions like these.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the field stays bunched entering the straight creating a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The 11 hold-up horses create chaos as they all look for racing room simultaneously in heavy going that doesn't suit quick acceleration. Only horses with clear runs or already positioned prominently can capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the better-rated hold-up horses gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: Despite the traffic concerns, a horse like Secret Magician or Majestic King uses superior class to power through when the gaps appear. The heavy ground actually suits their stamina-based profiles.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If even the prominent runners fail to quicken meaningfully
scenarios.body: The combination of heavy ground and lack of early pace creates such a tactical affair that any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Form and ratings become secondary to who handles the conditions best.

races.paceDynamic: Prom Queen will take the field along from the front with minimal early pressure, as most runners prefer to settle behind. Bhean Saibhre and Numidia may track in second and third, but neither is keen enough to force the pace. The heavy going and 1m5½f trip will create a stamina test, with the pace likely steady early before quickening from the 3f pole. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay the extended trip and handle the testing conditions, as the front-runner lacks the class to sustain pressure when challenged.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Prom Queen sets uncontested fractions and fades turning for home.
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade will sweep past the weakening leaders in the heavy ground. Horses like You Make Me Smile and Royal Belief who can quicken late over this trip will find themselves perfectly positioned.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bhean Saibhre or Numidia can get first run on the tiring Prom Queen.
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigner will use tactical speed to get first run before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. Bhean Saibhre's recent third behind these rivals gives her the form edge over the prominent runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Prom Queen maintains a strong gallop and the hold-up horses leave their run too late.
scenarios.body: The heavy going will blunt the finishing kicks of the hold-up horses, allowing the front-runner to hold on grimly. Prom Queen's light weight of 122lbs becomes crucial in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the heavy ground proves too testing for the fancied runners and stamina becomes paramount.
scenarios.body: A lightly-weighted hold-up horse with proven stamina will emerge from the pack to claim victory. The extended trip and conditions will suit horses who stay strongly rather than those with pure speed.

watchPoints.text: Prom Queen may get too soft a lead early and prove hard to peg back if the hold-up horses are slow to organize their challenge
